description: Angola's Instituto Nacional de Estatística publishes the definitive results of the 2024 General Population and Housing Census on a dedicated site, with a general report, annex tables and, for each of the 21 provinces, a PDF report and an Excel workbook. The provincial workbooks break households down by municipality and comuna for the main source of lighting, cooking energy, toilet type and sharing, drinking water treatment, access to the public water network and main water source, and dwellings by type and by wall, roof and floor material. Coverage is national through the 21 workbooks; in Luanda province, for example, about 1.84 million of 2.46 million households light their homes from the public grid and about 74,000 use solar panels. Format and access: free XLSX and PDF downloads, no registration. Licence: not stated on the pages read. Caveats: counts in the workbooks carry decimals, which suggests weighting, so treat them as estimates and check the report's notes; the comuna level is only in the provincial files. Simulation uses: comuna level grid, generator and solar shares for electrification planning, public water network access for service gaps, and roof and wall materials for flood and storm exposure. Related records: none for this census in the catalogue.

schema_summary: Each provincial workbook has about 73 sheets in 10 sections. Section 9 households by area, municipality and comuna: 9.1 main lighting (public grid electricity, generator, solar panel, wind, torch, lamp, candle, firewood, none), 9.2 energy or fuel for cooking, 9.3 toilet type, 9.4 drinking water treatment, 9.5 shared toilet, 9.6 access to public water network, 9.7 drinking water from the same source, 9.8 main water supply source. Section 10 family dwellings by municipality and area: 10.2 type, 10.3 occupancy, 10.4 outer wall, 10.5 roof and 10.6 floor materials, 10.7 rooms.
